name: whisper-tiny vs whisper-base in a browser tab: word error rate, timing, transfer size and peak memory
description: Measurements of two quantised Whisper tiers running client-side in a real Chrome window: word error rate on eight clips across five acoustic conditions, timing on byte-identical audio from 13 to 1610 seconds, per-file transfer size, peak resident memory, container decodability, and a single-clip Mandarin character error rate.
measurementTechnique: Chrome DevTools Protocol driving a real (non-headless) Chrome window; WER by DP alignment against reference transcripts; memory measured at OS level from the spawned process tree
softwareRequirements: Node.js 22 (CDP harness), Python 3.13 (optional: COOP/COEP static server, CER normalization)
